title: Deer in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Deer body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='22' ry='16' fill='#C97B3A'/>
  <!-- Body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='15' ry='10' fill='#D98E4D'/>
  
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='35' y='82' width='5' height='12' rx='2' fill='#B36A2E'/>
  <rect x='45' y='83' width='5' height='11' rx='2' fill='#C97B3A'/>
  <rect x='55' y='83' width='5' height='11' rx='2' fill='#B36A2E'/>
  <rect x='63' y='82' width='5' height='12' rx='2' fill='#C97B3A'/>
  
  <!-- Hooves -->
  <rect x='34' y='92' width='7' height='3' rx='1' fill='#5C3A1E'/>
  <rect x='44' y='92' width='7' height='3' rx='1' fill='#5C3A1E'/>
  <rect x='54' y='92' width='7' height='3' rx='1' fill='#5C3A1E'/>
  <rect x='62' y='92' width='7' height='3' rx='1' fill='#5C3A1E'/>
  
  <!-- Neck -->
  <rect x='45' y='42' width='10' height='16' rx='4' fill='#C97B3A'/>
  
  <!-- Scarf -->
  <path d='M36 52 Q50 60 64 52 L64 57 Q50 65 36 57 Z' fill='#E84855'/>
  <path d='M58 56 L62 68 L57 68 L54 58 Z' fill='#D13A46'/>
  <rect x='55' y='66' width='9' height='4' rx='2' fill='#E84855'/>
  
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='32' rx='15' ry='14' fill='#D98E4D'/>
  
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='22' rx='6' ry='9' fill='#C97B3A' transform='rotate(-20 35 22)'/>
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='22' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#F0A868' transform='rotate(-20 35 22)'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='22' rx='6' ry='9' fill='#C97B3A' transform='rotate(20 65 22)'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='22' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#F0A868' transform='rotate(20 65 22)'/>
  
  <!-- Antlers -->
  <path d='M42 18 L38 8 L34 12 M38 8 L42 4' stroke='#8B5E3C' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 18 L62 8 L66 12 M62 8 L58 4' stroke='#8B5E3C' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='30' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#2C1810'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='30' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#2C1810'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='29' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='29' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#5C3A1E'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='37.5' rx='1.5' ry='0.8' fill='#7A4E2A'/>
  
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M48 40.5 Q50 42 52 40.5' stroke='#8B5E3C' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Cheek spots -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='35' r='3' fill='#F0A868' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='35' r='3' fill='#F0A868' opacity='0.7'/>
  
  <!-- Tail -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='68' r='4' fill='#F0A868'/>
</svg>
